d.title: Fresh Precure! Movie: Omocha no Kuni wa Himitsu ga Ippai!?
d.jp: 映画 フレッシュプリキュア！おもちゃの国は秘密がいっぱい！？
syn: Fresh Pretty Cure! Movie: The Kingdom of Toys has Lots of Secrets!?
d.synopsis: During a slumber party Love comes across her old stuffed rabbit Usapyon. An abandoned toy seeking vengeance has taken over The Land of Toys and he's began to steal toys from all over. Its up to Pretty Cure to stop him and protect the feelings of children everywhere!
